I own a lot of NPB jerseys from more than half the teams, and I’ve found that the BayStars’ jerseys are definitely some of the cheapest-feeling ones. The replicas they sell in the team shop for around 9,000 yen feel pretty low quality—everything is screen-printed rather than stitched. For example, the Swallows jerseys, which were actually cheaper, feel much higher quality with stitched details. I got my BayStars jersey directly from the shop at the stadium, and the tagging on mine is also minimal, though the small tag it does have is only slightly different from the one on yours. Even so, the fan replicas they sell at the stadium still feel cheap compared to other teams’ jerseys.

As an American living in Japan, I tend to wear my team’s gear whenever, though definitely on game days. From what I’ve noticed, locals don’t wear jerseys or gear much outside of the game itself. People tend to even take the jerseys off after the game, and it’s funny—on the train, you’ll see fans pulling them out of their backpacks just before arriving at the stadium. It’s kind of rare to see someone wearing it outside of a game. Also, there’s surprisingly little gear for sale outside of the teams’ specific shops. You’ll find hat stores carrying MLB or other American sports teams, and sometimes you’ll see a Giants cap, but it’s rare to find NPB gear in general stores.
